title: On Time-Changed Linear Birth-Death Process with Immigration at Extinction
abstract: We study an immigration effect in the time-changed linear birth-death process where the immigration occurs only if the population goes extinct. We call this process as the time-fractional linear birth-death process with immigration (TFLBDPwI). Its transient probabilities are obtained using the Adomian decomposition method. In a particular case, we discuss the accuracy of approximation for the obtained transient probabilities. Also, the first two moments of TFLBDPwI are derived. Later, we consider some particular cases of the TFLBDPwI and study their distributional properties in detail.
